resources.string: The folder %1$s is gone. Pick another one in %2$s.
Choose the folder with your music: ASD only reads it, it never deletes anything.
M4A/AAC files (including those from TUBE) need the GStreamer decoder: sudo apt install gstreamer1.0-libav
Make one here, or press + next to a track in %1$s.
Blank tape. Go to %1$s and press + next to a track.
TUBE needs yt-dlp, which is not installed.
Install it with: pipx install yt-dlp (recommended: it updates from SETUP), or sudo apt install yt-dlp (often too old for YouTube). Then press RETRY.
Saving to %1$s: the tracks show up in STUFF.
If YouTube asks you to prove you are not a bot: pick a browser where you are signed in to YouTube, yt-dlp uses its cookies.
YouTube wants to know you are not a bot: in SETUP pick the browser where you are signed in to YouTube.
